endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: nc_french_broad_horse_shoe_baa_access_anchor_20260918 horse-shoe-boating-access-area-mile-41-5: The current French Broad Paddle Trail list identifies Horse Shoe Boating Access Area at mile 41.5, managed by Henderson County, lists it OPEN, and links to a Google Maps place that resolves to the stored route coordinate. NCWRC's access inventory independently names Horse Shoe at 5437 Brevard Road and describes a universally accessible boat ramp/canoe access; its published site coordinate is about 230 feet away and is treated as a facility anchor. Henderson County describes the park as providing parking and a boat put-in. Retain the route coordinate as the mapped public access-area anchor, not a surveyed water-entry toe, and confirm current post-storm conditions before travel.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (nc_french_broad_horse_shoe_baa_access_anchor_20260918 horse-shoe-boating-access-area-mile-41-5) on French Broad River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
